dedupe_keys.name: port said transit gtfs and route geojson

description: Port Said Transit GTFS publishes a local public-transport feed and route geometries for Port Said Governorate, Egypt. The GTFS folder lists agency, route, trip, stop, stop-time, shape, calendar and feed-information text files. The GEOJSON folder lists twelve named route files with line geometries for mapping. The project attribution identifies December 2025 creation, and the repository provides a CC BY-NC 4.0 licence requiring attribution and limiting commercial reuse. A modeller could use routes, schedules and shapes to build a bus or minibus service network, test accessibility or create a scheduled-demand scenario. The README warns that on-the-ground boarding and alighting can be flexible and may not match a fixed-stop representation. The repository does not give a formal survey method, route verification report or service-validity end date; it may evolve after the dated project release. The public file tree confirms publication, but GTFS rows, coordinate geometry and validator results were not opened or independently checked. No exact relation to an official transport-operator feed was established. It covers the regional Port Said service area. No directly related catalogue record was found for this feed.
